s: overall, in general

Man musste sehr tief in der Materie stecken, um von dem Vortrag überhaupt etwas zu verstehen.
You had to really know your stuff to understand anything at all of the talk.

s: to overstrain, to overstretch, to overreach
figuratively

to relieve someone from something
archaic

surplus, overhang (an excess of supply over demand, e.g., an "Angebotsüberhang" or "Nachfrageüberhang")
Ein großer Überhang an Verkaufsorders führte an der Wall Street zu einem raschen Kursverfall.
A large overhang of sell orders led to a rapid decline in prices on Wall Street.
overhang, projection (a part of a structure or rock face that protrudes or hangs over)
Die Bergsteiger suchten unter einem felsigen Überhang Schutz vor dem plötzlichen Gewitter.
The climbers sought shelter from the sudden thunderstorm under a rocky overhang.
excess (specifically regarding "Überhangmandate" in the German electoral system)
Durch die vielen Direktmandate entstanden im Bundestag zahlreiche Sitze durch den sogenannten Überhang.
Due to the many direct mandates, numerous seats were created in the Bundestag through the so-called overhang.
rest, remnant (something remaining or carried over from a previous period)
Der Sachbearbeiter musste erst den Überhang an unerledigten Akten aus der Urlaubszeit abarbeiten.
The clerk first had to work through the overhang of unfinished files from the vacation period.
overhang seat (in the German electoral system, a parliamentary seat that occurs when a party wins more direct mandates in a district than it is entitled to based on its share of the party vote)
Die hohe Zahl an Überhangmandaten führte in der Vergangenheit regelmäßig zu einer deutlichen Vergrößerung des Bundestages.
The high number of overhang seats regularly led to a significant enlargement of the Bundestag in the past.
Um den Proporz zwischen den Parteien wiederherzustellen, werden zusätzlich zu den Überhangmandaten sogenannte Ausgleichsmandate vergeben.
In order to restore proportionality between the parties, so-called leveling seats are awarded in addition to the overhang seats.
to force (something) on someone (to assign, steamroll or pressure into something not wanted)
informal
regional
Diese Verpflichtung wird den Kommunen übergeholfen.
